meta.title: About LifeSeos — Free SEO Tools
meta.description: Learn about LifeSeos, our mission, and the SEO tools and educational resources we build to make website analysis, technical SEO and content optimization simpler.

About.subtitle: LifeSeos provides practical SEO tools and educational resources designed to help creators, developers, marketers, and website owners understand their websites and identify opportunities for improvement.

mission.title: Make SEO easier to understand
mission.p1: SEO can feel complicated, especially when technical issues, metadata, content structure, performance, and search engine requirements are spread across many different tools and resources.
mission.p2: LifeSeos aims to bring useful SEO checks into one simple workspace, with clear results, practical recommendations, and tools that are easy to use.
mission.p3: We also publish educational SEO guides that explain the ideas behind the tools so users can understand why an issue matters instead of relying only on an automated score.

focus.analysisBody: Turn technical SEO signals into clearer results that are easier to review.
focus.recsBody: Highlight potential issues and provide practical next steps for further evaluation.
focus.toolsBody: Help users complete common SEO tasks without unnecessary complexity.
focus.guidanceBody: Explain SEO concepts so users can make informed optimization decisions.
focus.historyBody: Allow signed-in users to save supported SEO reports and review them later.

how.title: Tools support decisions — they do not replace them
how.body: LifeSeos combines automated checks with explanatory guidance. The tools can identify patterns, technical signals, metadata, content characteristics, and other SEO-related information, but automated results should always be reviewed in context.
how.step1Body: Use a LifeSeos tool to inspect a webpage, text, metadata, performance signal, or other supported SEO element.
how.step2Body: Review the results together with explanations, recommendations, and related educational guides.
how.step3Body: Decide which changes are appropriate for your website, then test and monitor the results.

toolkit.title: Tools designed for everyday SEO work
toolkit.body: LifeSeos combines practical SEO utilities in one place so you can analyze, generate, check, measure, and improve important website signals.

learning.title: Practical guides alongside the tools
learning.p1: Our SEO guides cover topics such as technical SEO, on-page optimization, metadata, page speed, HTTP status codes, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, keyword usage, and content analysis.
learning.p2: The goal is to provide useful context so users can understand what a tool is measuring and make their own informed decisions.
learning.principle1: Explain SEO concepts in clear and practical language.
learning.principle2: Avoid presenting arbitrary SEO scores as guarantees.
learning.principle3: Distinguish automated checks from editorial judgment.
learning.principle4: Update important guidance when tools, practices, or standards change.
learning.principle5: Focus on information that helps users make better website decisions.

approach.title: Clear, practical, and user-focused
approach.body: LifeSeos is built around a simple idea: useful SEO tools should be understandable, practical, and straightforward to use.
approach.clarityBody: Present results and explanations in a way that is easier to understand.
approach.practicalityBody: Focus on checks and recommendations that can support real website improvements.
approach.transparencyBody: Treat automated results as indicators rather than promises of search performance.
approach.privacyBody: Handle account, report and website usage information responsibly.

note.title: SEO results can vary
note.p1: LifeSeos tools and guides provide informational analysis and recommendations. Search engine rankings depend on many factors, and no SEO tool can guarantee a specific ranking, traffic level, indexing outcome, or search performance result.
note.p2: Users should review recommendations in the context of their own website, audience, technical environment, and business goals.

cta.title: Start with a free SEO analysis
cta.body: Run an SEO audit, review your website signals, and identify areas that may need further attention.
